rules.title: Rules
rules.text: Swipe or use the arrow keys (W, A, S, D work too): all tiles slide that way, and two equal tiles merge into one with double the value, which adds to your score. A new 2 or 4 appears after every move. The game ends when no move is left. “Finish” scores the current round. Undo takes back the last move, but only one move can be taken back.
